phases.title: Recover, pin and protect
phases.done_when: Input packages, current repo and lane preimages recorded.

phases.title: Absorb claim maintenance and watcher
phases.done_when: Watcher adopted locally; full plugin package requires exact-file transfer and owner-path replay.

phases.title: Canonical registry and 23-axis plan
phases.done_when: Separate emerging research dimensions from existing financial axes; resolve six undeclared goals and adapter pointers.

phases.title: Qualify instruments
phases.done_when: Exact bank/grader/config/system/domain; utility and failure controls; failed subject distinct from invalid instrument.

phases.title: Host identity, authority and effect binding
phases.done_when: Authenticated host context, scoped leases, audience, final normalized request, cancellation and replay contracts.

phases.title: Owned correction readbacks
phases.done_when: Operator-defined source/target revision contracts; current expected bytes observed from two owned surfaces; unknown global coverage.

phases.title: Authorized FIX and remeasurement
phases.done_when: Baseline/candidate/patch/instrument binding, separate reviewer, holdout/regression evidence and rollback.

phases.title: One reviewed public surface release
phases.done_when: Preserve other lanes UI/MCP repairs; one status source, existing full release gates, served-byte readback.

phases.title: All requested axes accounted for
phases.done_when: Fresh/reused/partial/unchecked/unsupported/blocked disposition for every axis; budget and sampling units preserved.

phases.title: RunPod staging, HF projection, automation
phases.done_when: Private no-inference replay first; existing worker only after P4/P6/P7; no duplicate scheduler or private-data publication.

phases.title: Group and regulator evidence packets
phases.done_when: Small reproducible contribution; confirm current venue/IPR/privacy/consent/authority and suppress duplicate replies.

phases.title: Measurement-only and measurement-plus-FIX
phases.done_when: Specific deliverable and customer acceptance; wallet/settlement/API counter not independent delivery evidence.

EAT_operating_chain: recover → deduplicate → pin → replay → compare → adopt scoped source → reviewed release → readback → learn
authority_note: Planning record is not execution or release authorization. No new spending, inference, signing, anchoring, submitting or publishing is authorized by this file.
